mapper.sql: c.id, c.conversation_id, c.member_id, c.title, c.create_time, c.update_time, (select count(1) from ai_customer_conversation_message m where m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id) as message_count
mapper.select: select from ai_customer_conversation c where c.member_id = #{memberId} order by c.update_time desc, c.id desc limit 100
mapper.insert: insert ignore into ai_customer_conversation_message ( message_id, conversation_id, sequence_no, role, content, public_response_json, create_time ) values ( #{messageId}, #{conversationId}, #{sequenceNo}, #{role}, #{content}, #{publicResponseJson}, now() )
mapper.select: select id, message_id, conversation_id, sequence_no, role, content, public_response_json, create_time from ai_customer_conversation_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by sequence_no asc, id asc limit 500
